- Make sure to download the new exclusion list and parent visit file ahead of time

```{bash input}
module load plink/2.00-alpha-091019
dataPrefix=/scratch.global/hbcd/full/full.QC8
release=br_20p1
releaseDir=../HBCD_genomics_release_${release}/data/
parFile="https://hbcddatamanagement.slack.com/files/U09L9E6QRB4/F09SX7CB6AY/par_visit_data.tsv"
```

```{bash setupDir}
mkdir -p $releaseDir
wget $parFile
mv par_visit_data.tsv $releaseDir/..
# push Ryans document to directory ahead of time
# local computer
# scp /c/Users/coffm049/Box/HBCD_genetics_QC/HBCD_genetics_QC1.xlsx coffm049@agate.msi.umn.edu:/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/hbcdGenomicReleaseCheck
```


```{r loadData}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(testthat)
library(kableExtra)
library(readxl)

dataPrefix="/scratch.global/hbcd/full/full.QC8"
release="br_20p1"
releaseDir=paste0("../HBCD_genomics_release_", release, "/data/")
batch <- read_table("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/batch.info") |>
  mutate(
    relationship = str_sub(IID, -1, -1),
    release_candid = as.numeric(str_sub(IID, end = -2)),
  ) |>
  select(-IID)
# parFile="https://hbcddatamanagement.slack.com/files/U09L9E6QRB4/F09SX7CB6AY/par_visit_data.tsv"
# par file needs to be downloaded first before running this
exc <- readxl::read_excel(paste0(releaseDir, "../HBCD_genetics_QC1.xlsx"), sheet = "Exclude_Summary") |>
  separate(`Sampled ID`, into = c("something", "release_candid", "pscidR"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    release_candid = as.numeric(release_candid),
    relationship = str_sub(Study_ID, -1, -1),
    pscid = str_sub(Study_ID, end =-2)
  ) |>
  select(-c(Study_ID, something, pscidR)) |>
  drop_na(relationship)

# Identifiers stay same
identifiers <- read_csv("../release_identifiers_20251006.csv") |>
    mutate(
      release_candid = as.numeric(release_candid),
      candid = as.numeric(candid),
  ) |>
  drop_na(release_candid)

fam <- read_table(paste0(dataPrefix, ".fam"), col_names=c("FID", "IID", "PAT", "MAT", "SEX", "PHENO")) |>
  mutate(
    pscidR = str_sub(IID, -10, -1),
    pscid = str_sub(IID, -10, -2),
    relationship = str_sub(IID, -1, -1),
    PHENO = "NONE"
  ) |>
  select(-c(pscidR, FID, IID))


parVisit <- read_table(paste0(releaseDir, "../par_visit_data.tsv")) |>
  # filter(session_id == "V01") |>
  # Genomics data only sampled once, so we can just use any occurence of a participant_id as a filter
  # as opposed to imaging data which is collected every visit
  distinct(candid = participant_id) |>
  drop_na()

combined <- left_join(fam, identifiers) |>
  left_join(batch) |>
  # this is a filter
  left_join(parVisit) |>
  mutate(
    FID = release_candid,
    IID = paste0(FID, relationship),
  )

renames <- grepl("^NA", combined$IID)
combined$IID[renames] <- paste0("NA", 1:sum(renames))

# write new deIDd fam
combined |>
  select(FID, IID, PAT, MAT, SEX, PHENO) |>
  write_delim(paste0(releaseDir, "../temp.fam"), delim = " ", col_names= F)
# write deIDd batch file
combined |>
  select(IID, visit, plate_number) |>
  filter(!grepl("^NA", IID)) |>
  # keeping excluded individuals since researchers might be interested in 
  # if many are excluded from same plate
  write_delim(paste0(releaseDir, "batch.info"), delim = " ")


# Write excludsion file
inclusion <- full_join(combined, exc, by = c("release_candid", "relationship")) |>
  mutate(
    FID = release_candid,
    IID = paste0(FID, relationship)
  )
inclusion |>
  filter(!is.na(`Exclusion Reason`) | is.na(FID) | grepl("^NA", IID)) |>
  filter(!grepl("^NA", IID)) |>
  write_delim(paste0(releaseDir, "../exclude.txt"), delim = " ")
inclusion |>
  filter(is.na(`Exclusion Reason`) & !is.na(FID)) |>
  distinct(FID, IID) |>
  write_delim(paste0(releaseDir, "../includePlink.txt"), delim = " ", col_names = F)


```


```{bash filterGenome}
plink2 --bfile $dataPrefix \
  --fam $releaseDir../temp.fam \
  --make-bed --out ${releaseDir}hbcd \
  --keep $releaseDir../includePlink.txt

cd ${releaseDir} 
rm HBCD*
rm *.log
```
